# Hackerland
> Open-Source Hardware, PCB Design Studio, and Innovation Network
> Website: https://www.hackerland.in/

## Overview
Hackerland is a developer and maker platform bridging open-source hardware prototyping and industrial manufacturing. It features an in-browser electronic design automation (EDA) studio with real-time SPICE circuit simulation, multi-layer FR4 PCB trace routing, Veroboard/Stripboard modeling with interactive track cuts, solderless breadboard simulation, and 3D WebGL photorealistic board visualization.

## Key Modules & URLs
- **A-Z PCB & Circuit Studio:** https://www.hackerland.in/manufacturing/pcb
  - Real-time transient SPICE circuit simulation (555 timer, transistors, op-amps, glowing LEDs, interactive switches and potentiometers).
  - Multi-substrate support: FR4 Multi-Layer PCB (Top/Bottom copper), Veroboard / Stripboard with track breaks, and Breadboard.
  - Automated Design Rule Checking (DRC) for clearance and trace width.
  - One-click industrial exports: RS-274X Gerber layers (GTL, GBL, GTO, GKO), Excellon NC Drill (DRL), BOM CSV, and KiCad PCB netlists.
- **3D Simulator Labs:** https://www.hackerland.in/manufacturing/physics/3d
  - Interactive 3D WebGL physics simulators for 7 engineering domains: Quadcopter Drones (6-DOF), Aerospace Rockets, Electric Vehicles, Formula Racecars, Superbikes, Bicycles, and MCU Embedded PCBs.
- **Manufacturing Hub:** https://www.hackerland.in/manufacturing
  - 8 engineering domains: PCB & Electronics, Drones & UAVs, Electric Vehicles, Aerospace & Propulsion, Robotics & Automation, Medical Devices, Renewable Energy, and Advanced Silicon.
- **Physics Simulators Suite:** https://www.hackerland.in/manufacturing/physics
  - 60 FPS physics engines with live telemetry streaming and parameter tuning.
- **Hardware Bounties & Grants:** https://www.hackerland.in/earn
  - Paid bounties and micro-grants for building open-source hardware, firmware, and software.
- **AI Hardware Co-Pilot & Sourcing Assistant:** https://www.hackerland.in/copilot
  - Engineering calculators for IPC-2152 trace sizing, SMPS buck filter design, thermal heatsink rating, BOM supply chain risk scrubbers, and live domestic Indian component pricing (Robu, Element14, KitsnSpares).
- **Digital Twin & Hardware Telemetry Stream Visualizer:** https://www.hackerland.in/telemetry
  - Real-time digital twin oscilloscope, 3D attitude gyro, AIS-156 16S battery pack balancer, and live WebSerial physical hardware UART debugging for drones, EVs, and CubeSats.
- **Hardware Firmware Registry & WebSerial Flasher:** https://www.hackerland.in/firmware
  - Verified open-source binary repository for ArduPilot Copter, Zephyr RTOS AIS-156 BMS, Meshtastic LoRa, Mindgrove RISC-V bootloader, and MicroPython with one-click in-browser USB flashing.
- **Indian Hardware Statutory Compliance & NABL Lab Wizard:** https://www.hackerland.in/compliance
  - Automated regulatory roadmap matcher, pre-compliance audit checklists, and laboratory testing CapEx estimators for BIS CRS, WPC ETA, TEC MTCTE, DGCA Drone Rules 2021, and AIS-156 Phase 2.
- **Remote Hardware-in-the-Loop Testbeds & Lab Benches:** https://www.hackerland.in/testbeds
  - Shared Keysight 20 GHz spectrum analyzers, Chroma 1000A regenerative battery cyclers, and Rohde & Schwarz anechoic chambers with remote SCPI execution and up to 60% student subsidies.
- **Component Sourcing & Drop-In Alternates Recommender:** https://www.hackerland.in/sourcing
  - Direct Indian & Asian electronic component cross-reference engine. Pin-to-pin drop-in replacement finder for supply-constrained ICs (STM32, TI BMS, Semtech LoRa) with domestic stock (Robu.in, Evelta, Element14) and HSN 8542 landed tariff & 18% GST calculators.
- **PCBA Assembly Line & SMT Stencil Visualizer:** https://www.hackerland.in/assembly
  - Interactive Pick-and-Place (PnP) 2D centroid visualizer, feeder tape loading planner, solder stencil aperture optimizer (0.10mm - 0.15mm foil), and turnkey assembly cost modeling across Indian tier-1 EMS plants (Kaynes, Syrma SGS, Centum, Dixon).
- **EMI / EMC Radiation Pre-Scan Analyzer & Near-Field Probe Visualizer:** https://www.hackerland.in/emc
  - Interactive conducted and radiated emission spectrum analyzer comparing measurements against CISPR 25 Class 5, CISPR 32 Class B, and MIL-STD-461G limits with 2D PCB near-field magnetic probe radiation heatmap diagnostics from SAMEER Chennai and ARAI Pune test chambers.
- **RF Impedance & Transmission Line Synthesizer:** https://www.hackerland.in/rf-calc
  - Closed-form electromagnetic waveguide solver synthesizing 50Ω single-ended, grounded coplanar waveguide (GCPW), and 100Ω differential pairs on Rogers RO4350B, RT/duroid 5880, Isola 370HR, and standard FR-4 laminates. Features conductor skin depth, copper surface roughness attenuation, and interactive Smith Chart conjugate matching networks.
- **48-Hour Rapid Hardware Sprints & Bounties:** https://www.hackerland.in/sprints
  - High-intensity 48-hour build sprints with milestone checkpoints (Hour 12 CAD, Hour 24 KiCad Schematic, Hour 36 RTOS Bringup, Hour 48 Physical Video Demo), non-dilutive cash grant escrows, free prototype fabrication credits, and NABL lab perks.
- **Milestone-Locked Hardware Launchpad & Grant Matcher:** https://www.hackerland.in/launchpad
  - Milestone-locked crowdfunding escrow and automated non-dilutive grant matcher for Indian schemes (iDEX DISC, BIRAC BIG, DST NIDHI-PRAYAS, MeitY TIDE 2.0, Semiconductor DLI) with mandatory 66% backer quorum governance.
- **Hardware & Deep-Tech Jobs & Fellowships:** https://www.hackerland.in/jobs
  - Proof-of-work hiring for aerospace, robotics, EV power electronics, BMS firmware, RISC-V silicon, and defense hardware engineering with lab bench specs, salary ranges in Lakhs, and skill matching.
- **Young Innovators Track & Safety Sandbox:** https://www.hackerland.in/young-innovators
  - Supervised K-12 engineering track for makers ages 8–17 with visual block-to-hardware MicroPython/C++ compilation, age-tiered challenges, and DPDP Act parental/educator co-signing.
- **Open Invention Network & IP Defense Ledger:** https://www.hackerland.in/network/ip
  - Cryptographic prior-art timestamping (RFC 3161 & Merkle proofs) for open hardware schematics, Gerber files, and mechanical CAD to invalidate predatory patent troll claims under USPTO § 102 and Indian Patents Act § 29.
- **Innovation Clubs & ATL Hub:** https://www.hackerland.in/clubs
  - Pan-India network of Atal Tinkering Labs (ATLs), collegiate robotics clubs, and community FabLabs with shared machine booking (3D printers, CNCs, scopes, rework) and intra-club build challenges.
- **Collaborative Squad Rooms & Escrow Vault:** https://www.hackerland.in/squads
  - Real-time squad rooms, milestone escrow vaults with proof-of-work release, and task kanban boards.
- **Idea-to-Prototype Hardware Architect:** https://www.hackerland.in/prototype
  - Interactive AI architecture synthesizer translating plain text ideas into block topologies, MCU pinouts, and BOMs.
- **Global Innovation Observatory:** https://www.hackerland.in/observatory
  - Real-time radar of expired public-domain patents, lab-to-market breakthroughs, open silicon shuttles, and non-dilutive deep-tech defense grants.
- **Failed Projects Museum & Risk Evaluator:** https://www.hackerland.in/museum
  - Engineering root-cause failure autopsies and pre-mortem risk evaluation calculators for hardware creators.
- **Hardware Reverse Engineering Teardowns:** https://www.hackerland.in/teardowns
  - Component-level autopsies, interactive PCB pinout hotspot annotator, and open-source drop-in alternatives for Ather 450 BMS, DJI drones, and smart electricity meters.
- **Teardown Submission Studio:** https://www.hackerland.in/teardowns/submit
  - Interactive reverse engineering workbench for engineers to map silicon pins, calculate retail vs BOM gross margins, and earn +150 XP credentials.
- **Makerspaces & ATL Labs:** https://www.hackerland.in/labs
  - Interactive directory of makerspaces, tinkering labs, 3D printing hubs, and CNC facilities across India.
- **Factory Blueprints (CapEx/OpEx):** https://www.hackerland.in/how-to-start
  - Complete industrial setup plans, equipment procurement lists, and financial models for manufacturing plants.
- **Explore Community Projects:** https://www.hackerland.in/projects
  - Open hardware projects with squad recruitment, portfolio work proofs, and discussion forums.
